films.title: Monsters and Men
films.overview: After capturing an illegal act of police violence on his cellphone, a Brooklyn street hustler sets off a series of events that alter the lives of a local police officer and a star high-school athlete.

films.title: Joe Bell
films.overview: The true story of a small town, working class father who embarks on a solo walk across the U.S. to crusade against bullying after his son is tormented in high school for being gay.

films.title: King Richard
films.overview: The story of how Richard Williams served as a coach to his daughters Venus and Serena, who will soon become two of the most legendary tennis players in history.

films.title: Bob Marley: One Love
films.overview: Jamaican singer-songwriter Bob Marley overcomes adversity to become the most famous reggae musician in the world.

films.title: The Punisher: One Last Kill
films.overview: As Frank Castle searches for meaning beyond revenge, an unexpected force pulls him back into the fight.
